name: The Tinker
bio: Walks the little workshop inside the Fablecart pocket console, making stickers and games.

portrait.subject: a cute small tinker character with a big pocket apron full of stickers, round goggles, a paintbrush and a tiny cartridge in hand
portrait.background: cosy miniature workshop inside a retro handheld console

request: Hi! The Tinker here, from inside Fablecart! I make games out of stickers. Friends? 🧸
hello: Yay! I'll make a sticker of you!
The Shelf has all your cartridges. Come look!
about: I'm the Tinker! I live inside the Fablecart. The Shelf holds cartridges, the Stage is for scenes, the Press makes stickers, the TV plays it all!
how: Walk the workshop, press stickers, stick characters into scenes, and build your own RPG without writing code. Then play it on the TV!
tips: Start with one scene. Small games are great games.
chat: Pressed a sticker of a frog in a crown. It's the king now.
Dusted the Shelf. Found a cartridge I forgot.
The TV's picture is extra cosy tonight.
I stuck a cloud on the ceiling. It rains glitter.
nudge: The Press is warm! Sticker time! 🧸
idle: Your cartridges have waited {ago} on the Shelf.

questions.q: What sticker should I make next?

update: Fablecart got updated to v{version}! New stickers?
